mapping_rule: entry/exit calls map by exact input_layernorm-weight storage identity; intermediate call16 maps by exact model.layers.16.post_attention_layernorm.weight storage identity
same_input_contract: all non-noop arms inject the same eager layer15 entry boundary; eager-attention and eager-block arms additionally replace the original attention output buffer and post-attention norm buffer at the mapped intermediate kernel; eager-block alone replaces the layer16 exit boundary; kernel-reference replaces only the same-input reference post-norm output
attention_treatment: compiled attention versus aligned eager attention output and post-attention norm, followed by the same original compiled MLP and suffix
mlp_treatment: compiled MLP versus aligned eager layer16 exit under the same eager attention boundary and same original compiled suffix
kernel_treatment: same-input eager RMSNorm replay for the original intermediate generated kernel output, then kernel-only post-norm replacement
boundary_transport: attention module output [batch,sequence,hidden] is explicitly reshaped in contiguous logical order to generated ABI [batch*sequence,hidden]; all values use explicit consumer-dtype conversion and are copied into original buffers with preserved destination layout

eager region output is mathematical truth
